subject: general
question: How much accident compensation was announced by Indian railways in June 2025 for its employees without paying any insurance premium?
solution:
The correct answer is __**₹1 crore**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In a major move to enhance social security for its workforce, the **Indian Railways** announced a significant hike in accident compensation in **June 2025**.
 
• The government has decided to provide a compensation amount of **₹1 crore** to the families of **railway employees** who lose their lives in the line of duty due to accidents.
 
• The most notable feature of this announcement is that the benefit is provided **without paying any insurance premium** by the employees, making it a fully government-funded welfare measure.
 
• This initiative was spearheaded by the **Ministry of Railways** to ensure that the families of the deceased receive substantial financial support immediately to cope with the loss of a breadwinner.
 
• The policy reflects a commitment to the welfare of the **unorganized and organized segments** within the railway sector, aiming to boost the morale of personnel working in high-risk operational environment
